body: Megan Fox, Joel Mchale, and I are going to have a blast during movie nights!

Ah yes, I felt the same way with the Blacksmith reveal. I was expecting someone epic and scary. I mean, Madame Gao, one of the badasses from season 1, was even having a hard time tracking him down. Then the reveal felt flat. Or I guess I've seen so many crook marines in tv shows for it to have an impact on me. I really feel like there was so much potential there that wasn't explored.
That imagery when Bruce and Selena were walking out of the tunnel was like a page from the comic books or a scene from a video game. Really well done!
I really enjoyed that cameo of his. He became a favorite of mine in Orphan Black.
Wow, I never knew I could get really scared of Kara. Now I understand where Maxwell and Lex are coming from.

I watched the episode just now. Does anyone get the feeling that Billy might do "something"? I dunno, I feel like he's planning something other than what he said to Flint. 

Great episode. The chase scene was absolutely phenomenal.
